title: Claude Projects Playbook: The Claude Projects mistake that's costing you hours
caption:
The Claude Projects mistake that's costing you hours

Unpopular truth about this:
1️⃣ Load your voice kit — Brand guide, 3 past posts, and target-customer notes go into one Project — raw material, not vibes.
2️⃣ Set a standing instruction — 'Match this voice; be concrete, no fluff.' Every chat opens with your rules, not a blank slate.
3️⃣ Ask for 10 hooks — It reuses your real examples instead of generic AI ones — keep the best 2, delete the rest.
4️⃣ Save winning prompts — Pin the best prompt as a Project instruction so next month's chat starts where this one ended.
